//! Store-neutral authority decisions over typed transaction capabilities.
//!
//! Storage adapters expose identity and work facts. This module alone walks
//! admission families and decides whether a session or claim still stands.

use crate::RuntimeError;

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod test_cases;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Authority {
    pub family: String,
    pub generation: i64,
    pub expires_at: i64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct SessionRecord {
    pub principal: String,
    pub family: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub digest: String,
    pub scope: SessionScope,
    pub cap_expires_at: Option<i64>,
    pub principal_generation: Option<i64>,
    pub expires_at: i64,
}

impl SessionRecord {
    pub(crate) fn identity_is_valid(&self) -> bool {
        refuse_nul(&[(&self.principal, "this session is not live; sign in again"),
            (&self.kind, "this session is not live; sign in again"),
            (&self.family, "this session is not live; sign in again")]).is_ok()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct WorkRecord {
    pub principal: String,
    pub state: String,
    pub claimed_by: Option<String>,
    pub session_digest: Option<String>,
    pub lease_until: Option<i64>,
    pub deadline: Option<i64>,
    pub admission: AdmissionRecord,
    pub service_generation: Option<i64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct AdmissionRecord {
    pub family: Option<String>,
    pub generation: Option<i64>,
    pub expires_at: Option<i64>,
}

/// The durable facts the authority kernel may read in one store transaction.
/// Implementations perform access only; the policy below interprets records.
pub(crate) trait AuthorityTransaction {
    fn principal_generation(&self, principal: &str) -> Result<i64, RuntimeError>;
    fn session_by_digest(&self, digest: &str) -> Result<Option<SessionRecord>, RuntimeError>;
    fn latest_live_family_member(
        &self,
        principal: &str,
        family: &str,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<Option<SessionRecord>, RuntimeError>;
    fn work_by_id(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Option<WorkRecord>, RuntimeError>;
    fn work_by_claimed_session_digest(
        &self,
        digest: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<WorkRecord>, RuntimeError>;

    fn invalidate_session(&self, digest: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;
    fn invalidate_family(&self, principal: &str, family: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;
}

pub(crate) enum AdmissionStanding {
    SessionNotLive,
    AuthorityNotLive,
    Live(Authority),
}

/// Resolve the credential captured at admission. Refresh may replace its row,
/// but the family and principal generation remain the durable authority.
// @ref LLP 3000.009#5.1 — action authority is bound at admission and walked inside one transaction.
pub(crate) fn admission_authority(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    token_digest: &str,
    principal: &str,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<AdmissionStanding, RuntimeError> {
    let Some(session) = tx.session_by_digest(token_digest)? else {
        return Ok(AdmissionStanding::SessionNotLive);
    };
    if !session.identity_is_valid() || session.scope != SessionScope::Full || session.principal != principal || session.expires_at <= now {
        return Ok(AdmissionStanding::SessionNotLive);
    }
    let generation = tx.principal_generation(principal)?;
    let Some(standing) = family_authority_expiry(tx, principal, &session.family, generation, now)?
    else {
        return Ok(AdmissionStanding::AuthorityNotLive);
    };
    Ok(AdmissionStanding::Live(Authority {
        family: session.family,
        generation,
        expires_at: session.expires_at.min(standing),
    }))
}

/// Walk a refresh/delegation family at one transaction snapshot. The admitted
/// expiry is deliberately not an ongoing cap: refresh lifetime and admission
/// lifetime are distinct. Claim leases and deadlines remain hard caps.
pub(crate) fn family_authority_expiry(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    principal: &str,
    family: &str,
    generation: i64,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<Option<i64>, RuntimeError> {
    if refuse_nul(&[(principal, "identity is not live"), (family, "identity is not live")]).is_err() { return Ok(None); }
    let current_generation = tx.principal_generation(principal)?;
    let (mut family, mut generation, mut bound) = (family.to_owned(), generation, i64::MAX);
    let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    loop {
        if refuse_nul(&[(&family, "identity is not live")]).is_err()
            || generation != current_generation || !seen.insert(family.clone()) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let Some(session) = tx.latest_live_family_member(principal, &family, now)? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        if !session.identity_is_valid() || session.scope != SessionScope::Full { return Ok(None); }
        bound = bound.min(session.expires_at);
        if session.kind != "action" {
            return Ok(Some(bound));
        }
        let Some(parent) = tx.work_by_claimed_session_digest(&session.digest)? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        if parent.principal != principal || !claim_window_is_live(&parent, now) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let lease = parent.lease_until.expect("a live claim has a lease");
        bound = bound.min(lease).min(parent.deadline.unwrap_or(i64::MAX));
        if let Some(service_generation) = parent.service_generation {
            return Ok((service_generation == current_generation).then_some(bound));
        }
        match (parent.admission.family, parent.admission.generation) {
            (Some(next), Some(next_generation)) => {
                family = next;
                generation = next_generation;
            }
            (None, None) => return Ok(Some(bound)), // Legacy work and development personas.
            _ => return Ok(None),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn work_authority_expiry(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    work: &WorkRecord,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<Option<i64>, RuntimeError> {
    if refuse_nul(&[(&work.principal, "identity is not live"),
        (work.admission.family.as_deref().unwrap_or(""), "identity is not live")]).is_err() { return Ok(None); }
    if let Some(generation) = work.service_generation {
        return Ok((tx.principal_generation(&work.principal)? == generation).then_some(i64::MAX));
    }
    match (&work.admission.family, work.admission.generation, work.admission.expires_at) {
        (Some(family), Some(generation), Some(_)) => family_authority_expiry(
            tx,
            &work.principal,
            family,
            generation,
            now,
        ),
        _ => Ok(Some(i64::MAX)), // Legacy rows and development personas.
    }
}

fn claim_window_is_live(work: &WorkRecord, now: i64) -> bool {
    work.state == "running"
        && work.lease_until.is_some_and(|lease| lease > now)
        && work.deadline.is_none_or(|deadline| deadline > now)
}

pub(crate) fn claim_is_owned(work: &WorkRecord, worker: &str, digest: &str) -> bool {
    work.claimed_by.as_deref() == Some(worker) && work.session_digest.as_deref() == Some(digest)
}

pub(crate) fn live_claim_authority(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    digest: &str,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    let Some(work) = tx.work_by_claimed_session_digest(digest)? else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    Ok(claim_window_is_live(&work, now) && work_authority_expiry(tx, &work, now)?.is_some())
}

pub(crate) fn held_claim_authority(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    id: &str,
    worker: &str,
    digest: &str,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    let Some(work) = tx.work_by_id(id)? else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    if !claim_is_owned(&work, worker, digest) {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    live_claim_authority(tx, digest, now)
}

pub(crate) fn live_session(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    digest: &str,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<Option<SessionRecord>, RuntimeError> {
    let Some(session) = tx.session_by_digest(digest)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    if !session.identity_is_valid() || session.expires_at <= now {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    // @ref LLP 3000.033#1.3 — revocation generations survive an older executable.
    if session.scope == SessionScope::Read
        && (session.cap_expires_at.is_none_or(|cap| cap <= now)
            || session.principal_generation.is_none()
            || session.principal_generation.unwrap() < tx.principal_generation(&session.principal)?) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if session.kind == "action" && !live_claim_authority(tx, digest, now)? {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    Ok(Some(session))
}

pub(crate) fn live_service_session(
    tx: &impl AuthorityTransaction,
    digest: &str,
    principal: &str,
    now: i64,
) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(tx.session_by_digest(digest)?.is_some_and(|session| {
        session.identity_is_valid() && session.scope == SessionScope::Full && session.principal == principal && session.kind == "service" && session.expires_at > now
    }))
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum SessionScope { Full, Read }

// @ref LLP 3000.009.001.000#9.1 — identity fails closed on both stores, including pre-upgrade SQLite rows.
// Lives here, not in `identity`, because authority is compiled without the SQLite feature.
pub(crate) fn refuse_nul(values: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    for (value, message) in values {
        if value.contains('\0') { return Err(RuntimeError::Auth((*message).into())); }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn preserves_only_live(tx: &(impl SessionClockTransaction + OutboxTransaction)) {
    preserve(tx, 1_000, 100).unwrap();
    tx.shift_worker_leases(1_000, 100).unwrap();
    let full = tx.session_by_digest("full").unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(full.expires_at,1_200);
    let read = tx.session_by_digest("read").unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((read.expires_at,read.cap_expires_at),(1_200,Some(1_220)));
    for digest in ["expired","cap-expired","revoked-read","closed-action"] {
        assert!(authority::live_session(tx,digest,1_100).unwrap().is_none(),"{digest} must stay dead");
    }
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("expired").unwrap().unwrap().expires_at,100);
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("cap-expired").unwrap().unwrap().cap_expires_at,Some(100));
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("revoked-read").unwrap().unwrap().expires_at,200);
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("worker").unwrap().unwrap().expires_at,1_200,"supervised family shifts exactly once");
    let claim = tx.work_by_id("running").unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(claim.lease_until,Some(1_180));
    assert_eq!(claim.deadline,Some(150),"product deadlines advance normally");
    assert!(authority::live_session(tx,"action",1_100).unwrap().is_none(),"the unchanged product deadline still fences the claim");
    let mints = tx.clock_mints(None).unwrap();
    for mint in mints {
        assert_eq!(mint.expires_at,if mint.intent == "live" { 1_200 } else if mint.intent == "expired" { 100 } else { 200 },"mint {}",mint.intent);
    }
    let row = tx.clock_sessions(false,None).unwrap().into_iter().find(|r| r.digest == "full").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(row.created_at,1_010,"refresh duration keeps its original width");
}

pub(crate) fn overflow_is_validated_before_writes(tx: &impl SessionClockTransaction) {
    let err = preserve(tx,i64::MAX,100).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err.code(),"E_INPUT");
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("full").unwrap().unwrap().expires_at,200);
    assert_eq!(tx.session_by_digest("read").unwrap().unwrap().cap_expires_at,Some(220));
    assert_eq!(tx.clock_mints(None).unwrap().into_iter().find(|m| m.intent == "live").unwrap().expires_at,200);
}

//! SQLite identity access. Identity policy stays in `crate::identity`.
// @ref LLP 3000.009.001.000#33-extraction-first-with-no-behavior-change — preserve statement order and transaction modes.
use super::{Store, Tx};
use crate::{
    RuntimeError,
    identity::{
        Credential, FullRotationRecord, IdentityStore, IdentityTransaction, PreparedSignup,
        ReadRotationRecord, Session, SessionMintRecord, SessionScope, digest,
    },

use rusqlite::{Connection, OptionalExtension, params};

// @ref LLP 3000.009#5.1 — refresh preserves admission authority; revocation changes its generation.
pub(super) fn initialize(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let columns: Vec<String> = conn
        .prepare("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('_sessions')")?
        .query_map([], |row| row.get(0))?
        .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
    if !columns.iter().any(|name| name == "family") {
        conn.execute_batch("ALTER TABLE _sessions ADD COLUMN family TEXT;")?;
    }
    conn.execute_batch("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS _sessions_family ON _sessions(principal, family, expires_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _principal_generations (principal TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generation INTEGER NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _session_mint_bindings (
            invocation TEXT NOT NULL, intent TEXT NOT NULL, input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
            principal TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, days INTEGER NOT NULL,
            expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, family TEXT NOT NULL, principal_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(invocation, intent)
        ) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    Ok(())
}

fn insert_session(conn: &Connection, session: &Session, now: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE expires_at <= ?1", [now])?;
    // @ref LLP 3000.033#1.3 — sign-in collects expired families; read rotation
    // remains limited to its own family, including at the immutable cap.
    if present(conn)? {
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _read_sessions WHERE expires_at <= ?1 OR cap_expires_at <= ?1",
            [now],
        )?;
    }
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _principals(id, kind, name, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, NULL, ?3)",
        params![session.principal, session.kind, now],
    )?;
    if session.scope == SessionScope::Read {
        return insert_read(conn, session, now, None);
    }
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO _sessions(token_digest, principal, kind, created_at, expires_at, family) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?1)",
        params![digest(&session.token), session.principal, session.kind, now, session.expires_at],
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

fn mint_binding_record(
    conn: &Connection,
    invocation: &str,
    intent: &str,
) -> Result<Option<SessionMintRecord>, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(conn.query_row(
        "SELECT input_digest, principal, kind, days, expires_at, family, principal_generation, scope FROM _session_mint_bindings WHERE invocation = ?1 AND intent = ?2",
        params![invocation, intent],
        |row| Ok(SessionMintRecord { scope: row.get(7)?, input_digest: row.get(0)?, principal: row.get(1)?, kind: row.get(2)?, days: row.get(3)?, expires_at: row.get(4)?, family: row.get(5)?, principal_generation: row.get(6)? }),
    ).optional()?)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.033#1.3 — only minting installs read-session storage.
pub(super) fn present(conn: &Connection) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(conn.prepare_cached("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' AND name = '_read_sessions')")?.query_row([], |r| r.get(0))?)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.033#1.3 — first mint installs storage; opening and refused operations preserve its absence.
fn initialize_read(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _read_sessions (
        token_digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        family TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        cap_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, principal_generation INTEGER NOT NULL
    ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS _read_sessions_family ON _read_sessions(principal, family, expires_at);")?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn initialize_binding_scope(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let has_scope: bool = conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('_session_mint_bindings') WHERE name = 'scope')", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
    if !has_scope {
        conn.execute_batch(
            "ALTER TABLE _session_mint_bindings ADD COLUMN scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full';",
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn insert_read(
    conn: &Connection,
    session: &Session,
    now: i64,
    family: Option<(&str, i64)>,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if !present(conn)? { initialize_read(conn)?; }
    let digest = digest(&session.token);
    let generation: i64 = match family {
        Some((_, generation)) => generation,
        None => conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT generation FROM _principal_generations WHERE principal = ?1",
                [&session.principal],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?
            .unwrap_or(0),
    };
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO _read_sessions(token_digest, principal, kind, family, created_at, expires_at, cap_expires_at, principal_generation) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)",
        params![digest, session.principal, session.kind, family.map_or(digest.as_str(), |f| f.0), now, session.expires_at, session.cap_expires_at.expect("read cap"), generation])?;
    Ok(())
}

fn set_family(conn: &Connection, digest: &str, family: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE _sessions SET family = ?2 WHERE token_digest = ?1",
        params![digest, family],
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

impl IdentityTransaction for Tx<'_> {
    fn insert_identity_session(&self, session: &Session, now: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        insert_session(self.conn(), session, now)
    }
    fn insert_read_session(
        &self,
        session: &Session,
        now: i64,
        family: Option<(&str, i64)>,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        insert_read(self.conn(), session, now, family)
    }
    fn initialize_mint_binding_scope(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        initialize_binding_scope(self.conn())
    }
    fn mint_binding_record(
        &self,
        invocation: &str,
        intent: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<SessionMintRecord>, RuntimeError> {
        mint_binding_record(self.conn(), invocation, intent)
    }
    fn record_session_mint(
        &self,
        invocation: &str,
        intent: &str,
        record: &SessionMintRecord,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().execute(
            "INSERT INTO _session_mint_bindings(invocation, intent, input_digest, principal, kind, days, expires_at, family, principal_generation, scope) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8, ?9, 'full')",
            params![invocation, intent, record.input_digest, record.principal, record.kind, record.days, record.expires_at, record.family, record.principal_generation],
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn set_identity_session_family(&self, digest: &str, family: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        set_family(self.conn(), digest, family)
    }
}

impl IdentityStore for Store {
    fn insert_identity_session(&self, session: &Session, now: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        insert_session(&self.conn, session, now)
    }
    fn insert_identity_session_atomic(
        &self,
        session: &Session,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        insert_session(&tx, session, now)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn close_identity_session(&self, digest: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1",
            params![digest],
        )?;
        if present(&self.conn)? {
            self.conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM _read_sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1",
                params![digest],
            )?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn full_rotation_record(
        &self,
        digest: &str,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<Option<FullRotationRecord>, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self.conn.query_row(
            "SELECT principal, kind, expires_at - created_at, COALESCE(family, token_digest) FROM _sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1 AND expires_at > ?2",
            params![digest, now],
            |row| Ok(FullRotationRecord { principal: row.get(0)?, kind: row.get(1)?, lifetime_ms: row.get(2)?, family: row.get(3)? }),
        ).optional()?)
    }
    fn delete_expired_identity_session(&self, digest: &str, now: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1 AND expires_at <= ?2",
            params![digest, now],
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn replace_full_session(
        &self,
        old_digest: &str,
        session: &Session,
        family: &str,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        tx.execute("DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE expires_at <= ?1", [now])?;
        let removed = tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1 AND expires_at > ?2",
            params![old_digest, now],
        )?;
        if removed == 0 {
            tx.commit()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        insert_session(&tx, session, now)?;
        set_family(&tx, &digest(&session.token), family)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(true)
    }
    fn signup_identity(
        &self,
        prepared: &PreparedSignup,
        session: &Session,
        now: i64,
        validate: impl FnOnce(Option<String>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        let taken = tx
            .query_row(
                "SELECT principal FROM _credentials WHERE email = ?1",
                [&prepared.email],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        validate(taken)?;
        tx.execute(
            "INSERT INTO _principals(id, kind, name, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'user', ?2, ?3)",
            params![session.principal, prepared.email, now],
        )?;
        tx.execute(
            "INSERT INTO _credentials(principal, email, hash) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)",
            params![session.principal, prepared.email, prepared.hash],
        )?;
        insert_session(&tx, session, now)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn identity_credential(&self, email: &str) -> Result<Option<Credential>, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self
            .conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT principal, hash FROM _credentials WHERE email = ?1",
                [email],
                |row| {
                    Ok(Credential {
                        principal: row.get(0)?,
                        hash: row.get(1)?,
                    })
                },
            )
            .optional()?)
    }
    fn login_identity(
        &self,
        principal: &str,
        session: &Session,
        now: i64,
        validate: impl FnOnce(Option<String>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        let current = tx
            .query_row(
                "SELECT hash FROM _credentials WHERE principal = ?1",
                [principal],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        validate(current)?;
        insert_session(&tx, session, now)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn rotate_read_session(
        &self,
        digest: &str,
        now: i64,
        mint: impl FnOnce(&ReadRotationRecord) -> Result<Option<Session>, RuntimeError>,
    ) -> Result<Option<Session>, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = rusqlite::Transaction::new_unchecked(
            &self.conn,
            rusqlite::TransactionBehavior::Immediate,
        )?;
        if !present(&tx)? {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let found = tx.query_row(
            "SELECT principal, kind, family, expires_at, cap_expires_at, principal_generation,
         COALESCE((SELECT generation FROM _principal_generations WHERE principal = r.principal), 0)
         FROM _read_sessions r WHERE token_digest = ?1",
            params![digest], |r| Ok(ReadRotationRecord { principal: r.get(0)?, kind: r.get(1)?, family: r.get(2)?, expires_at: r.get(3)?, cap_expires_at: r.get(4)?, principal_generation: r.get(5)?, current_generation: r.get(6)? })).optional()?;
        let Some(record) = found else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        let Some(session) = mint(&record)? else { return Ok(None); };
        tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _read_sessions WHERE family = ?1 AND principal = ?2",
            params![record.family, record.principal],
        )?;
        insert_read(
            &tx,
            &session,
            now,
            Some((&record.family, record.principal_generation)),
        )?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(Some(session))
    }
    fn revoke_identity_principal(&self, principal: &str) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        tx.execute("INSERT INTO _principal_generations(principal, generation) VALUES (?1, 1) ON CONFLICT(principal) DO UPDATE SET generation = generation + 1", [principal])?;
        let mut removed = tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE principal = ?1",
            params![principal],
        )? as u64;
        if present(&tx)? {
            removed += tx.execute(
                "DELETE FROM _read_sessions WHERE principal = ?1",
                params![principal],
            )? as u64;
        }
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(removed)
    }
    fn identity_session_expiry(&self, digest: &str) -> Result<Option<i64>, RuntimeError> {
        let mut expiry = self
            .conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT expires_at FROM _sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1",
                [digest],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        if expiry.is_none()
            && self.conn.query_row(
                "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' AND name = ?1)",
                ["_read_sessions"],
                |r| r.get::<_, bool>(0),
            )?
        {
            expiry = self.conn.query_row("SELECT MIN(expires_at, cap_expires_at) FROM _read_sessions WHERE token_digest = ?1", [digest], |r| r.get(0)).optional()?;
        }
        Ok(expiry)
    }
    fn is_supervised_family(&self, digest: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self.conn.query_row(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _sessions s JOIN _meta m
                 ON m.key = 'worker:family:' || COALESCE(s.family, s.token_digest)
                 OR (m.key = 'worker:session-family' AND m.value = COALESCE(s.family, s.token_digest))
                 WHERE s.token_digest = ?1)",
            [digest], |row| row.get(0),
        )?)
    }
    fn clear_worker_families(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        tx.execute("DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE principal = 'service:worker' AND COALESCE(family, token_digest) = (SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'worker:session-family')", [])?;
        tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('worker:session-family', 'worker:session-revision')",
            [],
        )?;
        tx.execute("DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE COALESCE(family, token_digest) IN (SELECT substr(key, 15) FROM _meta WHERE key LIKE 'worker:family:%')", [])?;
        tx.execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key LIKE 'worker:family:%'", [])?;
        // The next supervisor owns fresh reports, including removed declarations.
        tx.execute(
            "DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key = 'worker:status' OR key LIKE 'worker:status:%'",
            [],
        )?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn revoke_worker_family(&self, family: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        if let Some(family) = family {
            tx.execute(
                "DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE COALESCE(family, token_digest) = ?1",
                [family],
            )?;
            tx.execute(
                "DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key = ?1",
                [format!("worker:family:{family}")],
            )?;
        } else {
            tx.execute("DELETE FROM _sessions WHERE principal = 'service:worker' AND COALESCE(family, token_digest) = (SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'worker:session-family')", [])?;
            tx.execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('worker:session-family', 'worker:session-revision')", [])?;
        }
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    // Credential and ownership marker commit together, including failed ownership checks.
    fn mint_supervised_child(
        &self,
        named: bool,
        now: i64,
        revision: usize,
        mint: impl FnOnce() -> Result<Session, RuntimeError>,
    ) -> Result<Session, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.conn.unchecked_transaction()?;
        let session = mint()?;
        insert_session(&tx, &session, now)?;
        let family = digest(&session.token);
        if named {
            self.check_ownership()?;
            tx.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value", params![format!("worker:family:{family}"), revision.to_string()])?;
        } else {
            self.check_ownership()?;
            tx.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value", params!["worker:session-family", family])?;
            self.check_ownership()?;
            tx.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value", params!["worker:session-revision", revision.to_string()])?;
        }
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(session)
    }
}

impl crate::identity::test_cases::IdentityFixture for Store {
    type Transaction<'a> = Tx<'a>;
    fn with_identity_tx<T>(&self, run: impl FnOnce(&Tx<'_>) -> Result<T, RuntimeError>) -> Result<T, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = self.authority_transaction()?;
        let result = run(&tx)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(result)
    }
    fn principal_facts(&self, principal: &str) -> Option<(String, Option<String>, i64)> {
        self.conn.query_row("SELECT kind,name,created_at FROM _principals WHERE id = ?1", [principal], |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?))).optional().unwrap()
    }
    fn principal_ids(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.conn.prepare("SELECT id FROM _principals ORDER BY id").unwrap().query_map([], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap()
    }
    fn identity_row_counts(&self) -> [i64; 6] {
        ["_principals", "_principal_generations", "_sessions", "_read_sessions", "_credentials", "_session_mint_bindings"].map(|table| {
            if table == "_read_sessions" && !present(&self.conn).unwrap() { return 0; }
            self.conn.query_row(&format!("SELECT count(*) FROM {table}"), [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap()
        })
    }
    fn null_full_family(&self, digest: &str) {
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE _sessions SET family = NULL WHERE token_digest = ?1", [digest]).unwrap();
    }
    fn set_worker_meta(&self, key: &str, value: &str) { self.set_meta(key, value).unwrap(); }
    fn worker_meta(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> { self.meta(key).unwrap() }
}

//! Timing-critical maintenance and bulk catch-up share bounded engine slices.
use super::{Shared, lock, refusal_json, respond};
use serde_json::json;
use snapback4_core::RuntimeError;
use std::{sync::Arc, time::{Duration, Instant}};
use tiny_http::Request;

#[derive(Default, serde::Serialize)]
struct Work { delivery_chunks: usize, expired: u64, schedules: usize, chunks: usize, parked: usize, #[serde(skip)] fired: Vec<String> }

const WORK_TIME: Duration = Duration::from_millis(2);
const CONTENDED_TIME: Duration = Duration::from_micros(250);

// Charge consumed CPU for pacing, not time the OS already kept this thread off
// CPU. The cooperative chunk deadline still uses wall time. A failed clock
// sample falls back to the more conservative wall-time pause.
struct SliceClock { wall: Instant, cpu: Option<Duration> }
impl SliceClock {
    fn start() -> Self { Self { wall: Instant::now(), cpu: Self::cpu_time() } }
    fn cpu_time() -> Option<Duration> {
        let mut at = libc::timespec { tv_sec: 0, tv_nsec: 0 };
        if unsafe { libc::clock_gettime(libc::CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, &mut at) } != 0 { return None; }
        Some(Duration::new(at.tv_sec.try_into().ok()?, at.tv_nsec.try_into().ok()?))
    }
    fn consumed(&self) -> Duration {
        self.cpu.zip(Self::cpu_time()).and_then(|(start, end)| end.checked_sub(start)).unwrap_or_else(|| self.wall.elapsed())
    }
}

// Detached readers do not take engine tickets. Sample OS load as well as the
// round-3 engine contention signal; cache the syscall for 100 ms. Load includes
// other tenants and trails short bursts, so this is a pacing hint, not admission.
fn host_contended() -> bool {
    use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
    static SAMPLE: Mutex<(Option<Instant>, bool)> = Mutex::new((None, false));
    static CPUS: OnceLock<usize> = OnceLock::new();
    let mut sample = lock(&SAMPLE);
    if sample.0.is_none_or(|at| at.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(100)) {
        let mut load = 0.0;
        let cpus = *CPUS.get_or_init(|| std::thread::available_parallelism().map_or(1, |n| n.get()));
        sample.1 = unsafe { libc::getloadavg(&mut load, 1) } == 1 && load >= cpus as f64;
        sample.0 = Some(Instant::now());
    }
    sample.1
}

fn engine_work<T>(shared: &Shared, run: impl FnOnce(&mut snapback4_core::Engine, Duration) -> T) -> T {
    let mut engine = shared.engine.background();
    lock(&shared.readers).retry_missing(&engine);
    let budget = if engine.contended() || host_contended() { CONTENDED_TIME } else { WORK_TIME };
    let result = run(&mut engine, budget);
    // Publish from this guard: a second ordinary admission would both delay
    // notification and mistake maintenance for a newly arrived request.
    shared.publish_engine(&engine);
    result
}

fn phase<T: Default>(shared: &Shared, result: Result<T, RuntimeError>, drain: bool, name: &str) -> Result<T, RuntimeError> {
    match result {
        Err(error) if !drain => { super::adoption::background_failure(shared, name, &error); Ok(T::default()) }
        other => other,
    }
}

// @ref LLP 3000#7-decisions-during-execution — lifetimes are swept into the partition log; missed schedule boundaries fire once.
fn work(shared: &Shared, drain: bool, tick: u64) -> Result<Work, RuntimeError> {
    work_at(shared, drain, tick, None)
}

fn work_at(shared: &Shared, drain: bool, tick: u64, schedule_sample: Option<i64>) -> Result<Work, RuntimeError> {
    let mut work = Work::default();
    shared.ephemeral.sweep(shared.now())?;
    work.delivery_chunks = delivery(shared, drain)?;
    loop {
        if phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.run_view_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget)), drain, "view recount")?.is_none() {break;}
        work.chunks += 1;
        if !drain && work.chunks >= 500 {break;}
        std::thread::yield_now();
    }
    loop {
        let swept = phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.sweep_expired_for(shared.now(), 2_000, budget)), drain, "the expiry sweep")?;
        work.expired += swept;
        if !drain || swept == 0 { break; }
    }
    // @ref LLP 3000.007#20.2 — advancing a replay clock does not release its schedule hold.
    if !shared.hold_schedules {
        let fired = phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, _| {
            // @ref LLP 3000.007#20.12.2 — select advance windows before draining; admission deadlines still use the live advanced clock.
            if let Some(sample) = schedule_sample {
                let windows = engine.schema().schedules.iter().enumerate().map(|(index, schedule)| (index, schedule.boundary(sample))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
                let mut fired = Vec::new();
                for (index, boundary) in windows { fired.extend(engine.fire_schedule_boundary_at(shared.now(), index, boundary)?); }
                Ok(fired)
            } else { engine.fire_schedules(shared.now()) }
        }), drain, "schedules")?;
        work.schedules = fired.len();
        for name in &fired { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: schedule {name} fired"); }
        work.fired = fired;
    }
    while drain || work.chunks < 500 {
        if crate::lifecycle::stopping() { break; }
        let (run, logs) = engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| {
            let run = engine.run_job_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget);
            (run, engine.take_native_logs())
        });
        for line in logs { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: native {line}"); }
        let Some(run) = phase(shared, run, drain, "job")? else { break; };
        work.chunks += 1;
        match run.state {
            snapback4_core::JobState::Done => snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: job {} done: {} chunk{}, {} row{} written", run.name, run.chunks, if run.chunks == 1 { "" } else { "s" }, run.rows_written, if run.rows_written == 1 { "" } else { "s" }),
            snapback4_core::JobState::Parked => {
                work.parked += 1;
                if shared.personas { shared.refusals.job(&run); }
                snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: job {} parked after {} chunks: {}", run.name, run.chunks, run.error.as_deref().unwrap_or(""));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        // FIFO engine admission hands waiting requests their turn before the
        // next chunk; yield_now alone cannot make that promise for a mutex.
    }
    if drain || tick % 5 == 0 {
        loop {
            let actions = phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.requeue_expired_actions_for(shared.now(), budget)), drain, "the action lease sweep")?;
            let effects = phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.requeue_expired_effects_for(shared.now(), budget)), drain, "the effect lease sweep")?;
            if actions + effects > 0 { shared.durable_committed(&lock(&shared.engine)); }
            if effects > 0 { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: {effects} effect lease{} expired; queued again", if effects == 1 { "" } else { "s" }); }
            if !drain || actions + effects == 0 { break; }
        }
    }
    if drain || tick % 60 == 0 {
        phase(shared, (|| {
            let mut sweep = engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.prepare_asset_sweep_for(shared.now(), budget))?;
            sweep.remove_files()?;
            while !sweep.is_empty() { engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.finish_asset_sweep_for(&mut sweep, budget))?; }
            Ok(())
        })(), drain, "the asset sweep")?;
    }
    Ok(work)
}

fn delivery(shared: &Shared, drain: bool) -> Result<usize, RuntimeError> {
    let mut chunks = 0;
    while drain || chunks < 500 {
        if crate::lifecycle::stopping() { break; }
        if phase(shared, engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.run_timeline_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget)), drain, "timeline delivery")?.is_none() { break; }
        chunks += 1;
    }
    Ok(chunks)
}

// @ref LLP 3000#contended-read-serving — ordinary-priority bulk work yields
// outside every shared lock. Aged service protects finite backlogs from traffic.
const BULK_AGE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum BulkKind { Delivery, Recount, Job }
pub(super) struct State {
    next: BulkKind,
    serviced: Instant,
    resume_at: Instant,
    empty_pause: Duration,
    advancing: bool,
    // Explicit mutation-boundary tests pause all background maintenance until drain.
    paused: bool,
    // Separate clock callers (and a dev reset) may wait here; maintenance never takes this lock.
    pub(super) advance: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<()>>,
}
impl Default for State {
    fn default() -> Self {
        let now = Instant::now();
        Self { next: BulkKind::Delivery, serviced: now, resume_at: now, empty_pause: Duration::ZERO,
            advancing: false, paused: false, advance: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(())) }
    }
}
impl State {
    fn aged(&self, now: Instant) -> bool { now.saturating_duration_since(self.serviced) >= BULK_AGE }
    fn eligible(&self, now: Instant, aged_only: bool) -> bool {
        !self.advancing && !self.paused && if aged_only { self.aged(now) } else { now >= self.resume_at }
    }
    fn completed(&mut self, now: Instant, elapsed: Duration, contended: bool, worked: bool) {
        self.next = match self.next { BulkKind::Delivery => BulkKind::Recount, BulkKind::Recount => BulkKind::Job, BulkKind::Job => BulkKind::Delivery };
        self.serviced = now;
        // Target 1/8 CPU duty under contention, charging consumed thread CPU,
        // including atomic overruns. Cap at 100 ms; aged service is independent.
        let cap = Duration::from_millis(100);
        let charged = if contended { (elapsed * 7).min(cap) } else { Duration::ZERO };
        self.empty_pause += charged;
        // @ref LLP 3000#contended-read-serving — empty kinds keep their CPU
        // charge, but repay it with the next useful slice or the empty cycle.
        // Avoid two extra scheduler wakeups for every single delivery slice.
        let pause = if worked || self.empty_pause >= cap { self.empty_pause.min(cap) } else { Duration::ZERO };
        self.empty_pause -= pause;
        // An aged slice can finish after bulk flushes empty-cycle debt. Append
        // this charge without discarding repayment still owed in that ordering.
        self.resume_at = self.resume_at.max(now) + pause;
    }

    fn empty_cycle(&mut self, now: Instant) -> Duration {
        let pause = std::mem::take(&mut self.empty_pause);
        // A timed worker may just have scheduled repayment. Append remaining
        // debt rather than overlapping (and losing) either charge.
        self.resume_at = self.resume_at.max(now) + pause;
        self.resume_at.saturating_duration_since(now)
    }
}

// Admission owns no maintenance gate. Once admitted, the engine serializes the
// cursor's read -> chunk commit -> advance; the gate only protects small state
// accesses. Ordinary work never waits for a bulk thread to enter the engine.
fn bulk_slice(shared: &Shared, aged_only: bool) -> bool {
    if !lock(&shared.maintenance).eligible(Instant::now(), aged_only) { return false; }
    engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| {
        let kind = {
            let state = lock(&shared.maintenance);
            if !state.eligible(Instant::now(), aged_only) { return false; }
            state.next
        };
        let started = SliceClock::start();
        let result = match kind {
            BulkKind::Delivery => engine.run_timeline_turn_for(shared.now(), budget).map(|r| r.is_some()),
            BulkKind::Recount => engine.run_view_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget).map(|r| r.is_some()),
            BulkKind::Job => {
                let run = engine.run_job_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget);
                for line in engine.take_native_logs() { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: native {line}"); }
                run.map(|run| {
                    if let Some(run) = &run {
                        match run.state {
                            snapback4_core::JobState::Done => snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: job {} done: {} chunks, {} rows written", run.name, run.chunks, run.rows_written),
                            snapback4_core::JobState::Parked => {
                                if shared.personas { shared.refusals.job(run); }
                                snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: job {} parked after {} chunks: {}", run.name, run.chunks, run.error.as_deref().unwrap_or(""));
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }
                    }
                    run.is_some()
                })
            }
        };
        lock(&shared.maintenance).completed(Instant::now(), started.consumed(), budget == CONTENDED_TIME || shared.engine.has_waiters(), result.as_ref().map_or(true, |worked| *worked));
        phase(shared, result, false, "bulk maintenance").unwrap_or(false)
    })
}

fn timely_engine_work<T: Default>(shared: &Shared, run: impl FnOnce(&mut snapback4_core::Engine, Duration) -> Result<T, RuntimeError>) -> Result<T, RuntimeError> {
    let result = engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| {
        if { let state = lock(&shared.maintenance); state.advancing || state.paused } { return Ok(T::default()); }
        run(engine, budget)
    });
    promote_aged(shared, Instant::now());
    result
}

fn timely(shared: &Shared, tick: u64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    phase(shared, timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.sweep_expired_for(shared.now(), 2_000, budget)), false, "the expiry sweep")?;
    if !shared.hold_schedules {
        let count = timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, _| Ok(engine.schema().schedules.len()))?;
        for index in 0..count {
            // One atomic boundary per admission, never the entire schedule set.
            // Adoption between slices is harmless: the next tick visits its set.
            let fired = phase(shared, timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, _| engine.fire_schedule_at(shared.now(), index)), false, "schedules")?;
            for name in fired { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: schedule {name} fired"); }
        }
    }
    if tick % 5 == 0 {
        phase(shared, timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| {
            let result = engine.requeue_expired_actions_for(shared.now(), budget);
            if result.as_ref().is_ok_and(|n| *n > 0) { shared.durable_committed(engine); }
            result
        }), false, "the action lease sweep")?;
        let effects = phase(shared, timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| {
            let result = engine.requeue_expired_effects_for(shared.now(), budget);
            if result.as_ref().is_ok_and(|n| *n > 0) { shared.durable_committed(engine); }
            result
        }), false, "the effect lease sweep")?;
        if effects > 0 { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: {effects} effect leases expired; queued again"); }
    }
    if tick % 60 == 0 {
        phase(shared, (|| {
            let Some(mut sweep) = timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.prepare_asset_sweep_for(shared.now(), budget).map(Some))? else { return Ok(()); };
            // Bounded stale batch; filesystem work owns no engine lock.
            sweep.remove_files()?;
            while !sweep.is_empty() {
                // A clock drain that began between file removal and retirement
                // owns the sweep now. Its durable metadata also permits retry
                // on the next asset tick; do not spin on skipped slices.
                if timely_engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| engine.finish_asset_sweep_for(&mut sweep, budget))? == 0 { break; }
            }
            Ok(())
        })(), false, "the asset sweep")?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn maintain(shared: Arc<Shared>) {
    let mut tick = 0;
    let mut last_tick = Instant::now();
    loop {
        if crate::lifecycle::stopping() { return; }
        {
            let state = lock(&shared.maintenance);
            if !state.advancing && !state.paused && let Err(error) = shared.ephemeral.sweep(shared.now()) { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: ephemeral sweep: {error}"); }
        }
        if last_tick.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(1) {
            tick += 1; last_tick = Instant::now();
            // One bounded reclamation slice; abandoned bytes remain charged
            // until their actual records are dropped. No engine lock is held.
            lock(&shared.following).reclaim(shared.now(), snapback4_core::Ceilings { heap_bytes: 1 << 20, ..Default::default() });
            if let Err(error) = timely(&shared, tick) { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: maintenance failed: {error}"); }
        }
        promote_aged(&shared, Instant::now());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
    }
}

fn promote_aged(shared: &Shared, now: Instant) {
    if lock(&shared.maintenance).eligible(now, true) { bulk_slice(shared, true); }
}

pub(super) fn bulk(shared: Arc<Shared>) {
    loop {
        if crate::lifecycle::stopping() { return; }
        let observed = *lock(&shared.seq);
        let mut did_work = false;
        for _ in 0..3 {
            if crate::lifecycle::stopping() { return; }
            did_work |= bulk_slice(&shared, false);
            let pause = lock(&shared.maintenance).resume_at.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
            if !pause.is_zero() {
                // No shared lock survives this pause. Request commits do not
                // cancel repayment; empty kinds do not idle an active cycle.
                std::thread::sleep(pause.min(Duration::from_millis(100)));
            }
        }
        if !did_work {
            loop {
                let pause = lock(&shared.maintenance).empty_cycle(Instant::now());
                if pause.is_zero() { break; }
                std::thread::sleep(pause.min(Duration::from_millis(100)));
            }
            let seq = lock(&shared.seq);
            if *seq == observed {
                drop(shared.committed.wait_timeout(seq, Duration::from_millis(100)).unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()));
            }
        }
    }
}

// Reset even when a debug/unwind request panics mid-drain. Engine poison
// recovery and durable work cursors retain the normal retry semantics.
struct Advancing<'a>(&'a Shared);
impl Drop for Advancing<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let mut state = lock(&self.0.maintenance);
        state.advancing = false;
        state.next = BulkKind::Delivery;
    }
}

fn completed_drain(work: Work, stopping: bool) -> Result<Work, snapback4_core::Refusal> {
    if stopping {
        return Err(snapback4_core::Refusal::new("E_CLOCK_INTERRUPTED", "clock", "clock advanced, but host shutdown interrupted the drain; inspect queued work instead of repeating the advance").guide("clock"));
    }
    Ok(work)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#4-staging-clock — staging grants clock control, never fixture or persona authority.
pub(super) fn staging(shared: &Shared) -> bool {
    lock(&shared.engine).store().deployment_environment().ok().flatten().as_deref() == Some("staging")
}
fn clock_service(request: &Request, shared: &Shared) -> Result<Option<String>, snapback4_core::Refusal> {
    if shared.personas { return Ok(None); }
    if !staging(shared) { return Err(crate::dev_clock::release()); }
    match super::session_identity::principal_of(request,shared) {
        Ok((principal,kind,snapback4_core::identity::SessionScope::Full)) if kind == "service" && principal.starts_with("service:") => Ok(Some(principal)),
        _ => Err(snapback4_core::Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "staging clock control requires a full service token").guide("clock")),
    }
}
pub(super) fn advance(request: Request, shared: &Shared, body: &str) {
    let service = match clock_service(&request, shared) {
        Ok(service) => service,
        Err(why) => return respond(request,403,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&why)})),
    };
    let payload = match serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(body) {
        Ok(payload) => payload,
        Err(_) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&crate::dev_clock::input("clock advance takes {\"duration\":\"+2m\"}"))})),
    };
    let each_boundary = match payload.get("eachBoundary") {
        None => false,
        Some(serde_json::Value::Bool(value)) => *value,
        Some(_) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&crate::dev_clock::input("eachBoundary must be a boolean"))})),
    };
    let boolean = |key: &str, default: bool| -> Result<bool, snapback4_core::Refusal> {
        match payload.get(key) {
            None => Ok(default), Some(serde_json::Value::Bool(value)) => Ok(*value),
            Some(_) => Err(crate::dev_clock::input(format!("{key} must be a boolean"))),
        }
    };
    let (drain, allow_held) = match boolean("drain", true).and_then(|drain| Ok((drain, boolean("allowHeld", false)?))) {
        Ok(options) => options,
        Err(error) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error)})),
    };
    if each_boundary && !drain { return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&crate::dev_clock::input("eachBoundary requires drain:true"))})); }
    let preserve_sessions = match payload.get("sessions").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
        None if payload.get("sessions").is_none() => !shared.personas,
        Some("preserve") if !shared.personas => true,
        Some("expire") => false,
        _ => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&crate::dev_clock::input("sessions must be preserve (staging only) or expire"))})),
    };
    let duration = payload.get("duration").and_then(|value| value.as_str());
    let milliseconds = match duration.ok_or_else(|| crate::dev_clock::input("clock advance takes {\"duration\":\"+2m\"}"))
        .and_then(|duration| if duration == "0ms" && drain { Ok(0) } else { crate::dev_clock::duration(duration) }) {
        Ok(milliseconds) => milliseconds,
        Err(error) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error)})),
    };
    // Serialize clock callers only. Background slices check advancing after
    // engine admission and skip during this synchronous drain.
    let advance = lock(&shared.maintenance).advance.clone();
    let _advance = lock(&advance);
    let _advancing = Advancing(shared);
    // @ref LLP 3000.007#20.12 — simulated time makes retries due without stealing a live worker's claim or viewer session.
    let advanced = (|| {
        // Match claims' engine-then-clock lock order: no claim can land
        // between shifting its lease and publishing the advanced clock.
        let mut engine = lock(&shared.engine);
        let before = crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine);
        if let Some(principal) = &service {
            if engine.store().deployment_environment().map_err(|e|e.refusal())?.as_deref() != Some("staging") { return Err(crate::dev_clock::release()); }
            super::session_identity::mutation_authority(&request,shared,&engine,principal)?;
        } else { shared.dev_authority(&engine)?; }
        let mut clock = lock(&shared.clock);
        let floor = shared.time_audience_clock.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire);
        let effective_before = clock.now().max(floor);
        let mut next = clock.clone();
        let now = (if milliseconds == 0 { next.now() } else { next.advance(milliseconds)? }).max(floor);
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.001#11-wave-22-loop-repairs-dx6 — refuse a saved boundary before any clock/session effect.
        if drain && !allow_held && !shared.hold_schedules {
            crate::dev_clock_store::refuse_held(&engine, &before, clock.now(), now)?;
        }
        let boundaries = crate::dev_clock_store::crossed_boundaries(&engine, &before, now, shared.hold_schedules || !drain, each_boundary)?;
        lock(&shared.maintenance).advancing = true;
        if !shared.personas {
            // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.001#11-wave-22-loop-repairs-dx6 — a retained disclosure floor is also the credential authority clock.
            // A raw jump below that floor advances no business time and cannot
            // extend credentials or leases. Selection must never see an older
            // raw process time and revive an already expired family.
            let effective_delta = now.checked_sub(effective_before)
                .ok_or_else(|| crate::dev_clock::input("effective clock advance overflow"))?;
            if milliseconds > 0 && effective_delta > 0 { engine.advance_staging_clock_at(effective_delta, effective_before, preserve_sessions).map_err(|e|e.refusal())?; }
        } else if milliseconds > 0 {
            engine.advance_worker_leases_at(milliseconds, clock.now()).map_err(|e|e.refusal())?;
        }
        lock(&shared.maintenance).paused = true;
        *clock = next;
        let offset = clock.offset();
        let skew = now - snapback4_core::now_ms();
        let isolated = if crate::dev_clock_store::has_data(&engine) {
            format!("; use {} for isolated time tests; clock advance --port N targets its printed port (guide jobs)", crate::dev_clock::isolated_command())
        } else { String::new() };
        let message = format!("cumulative offset {offset:+}ms (requested process offset; now includes the authoritative floor); process offset lasts until restart{isolated}");
        Ok((now, clock.now(), offset, skew, message, before, boundaries))
    })();
    let (now, raw_now, offset, skew, message, before, boundaries) = match advanced {
        Ok(result) => result,
        Err(error) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error)})),
    };
    // @ref LLP 3000#contended-read-serving — a developer is awaiting this
    // request; synchronous clock-advance work intentionally keeps request QoS.
    let drained = (|| {
        if !drain { return Ok(Work::default()); }
        let mut crossed = Vec::new();
        if each_boundary {
            for (index, at) in boundaries {
                crossed.extend(engine_work(shared, |engine, _| engine.fire_schedule_boundary_at(shared.now(), index, at))?);
            }
        }
        let mut work = work_at(shared, true, 0, Some(now))?;
        work.schedules += crossed.len();
        work.fired.extend(crossed);
        Ok::<_, RuntimeError>(work)
    })();
    match drained.map_err(|error| error.refusal()).and_then(|work| completed_drain(work, crate::lifecycle::stopping())) {
        Ok(work) => {
            lock(&shared.maintenance).paused = !drain;
            let schedules = crate::dev_clock_store::schedule_report(&lock(&shared.engine), &before, &work.fired, now, raw_now, shared.hold_schedules || !drain, each_boundary, shared.dev_identity.as_ref().map(|i| i.address.port()));
            let (fired, held) = crate::dev_clock_store::outcomes(&schedules);
            respond(request, 200, json!({"now":now, "advancedMs":milliseconds, "sessionNotice":if preserve_sessions { crate::dev_clock::PRESERVED_SESSION_NOTICE } else { crate::dev_clock::SESSION_NOTICE }, "maintenancePaused":!drain, "sessionsPreserved":preserve_sessions, "offsetMs":offset, "skewMs":skew, "eachBoundary":each_boundary, "message":message, "work":work, "schedules":schedules, "fired":fired, "held":held}))
        }
        // Time remains advanced on failure. Stay paused until an explicit drain;
        // never retry an ambiguous advance to resume pending work.
        Err(error) => {
            let engine = lock(&shared.engine);
            let after = crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine);
            let fired: Vec<_> = engine.schema().schedules.iter().enumerate().filter(|(i, _)| {
                matches!((before.get(*i).copied().flatten(), after.get(*i).copied().flatten()), (Some(old), Some(new)) if new > old)
            }).map(|(_, schedule)| schedule.name.clone()).collect();
            let mut schedules = crate::dev_clock_store::schedule_report(&engine, &before, &fired, now, raw_now, shared.hold_schedules || !drain, each_boundary, shared.dev_identity.as_ref().map(|i| i.address.port()));
            for (index, schedule) in schedules.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                if schedule["fired"] != true && !shared.hold_schedules && before.get(index).copied().flatten().is_some_and(|old| old < engine.schema().schedules[index].boundary(now)) {
                    schedule["holdCode"] = "maintenance-failed".into();
                    schedule["reason"] = "clock advanced but maintenance stopped before this due boundary was queued; inspect clock and queued jobs before continuing; do not replay the advance".into();
                }
            }
            let (fired, held) = crate::dev_clock_store::outcomes(&schedules);
            respond(request, 500, json!({"now":now, "advancedMs":milliseconds, "sessionNotice":if preserve_sessions { crate::dev_clock::PRESERVED_SESSION_NOTICE } else { crate::dev_clock::SESSION_NOTICE }, "maintenancePaused":true, "sessionsPreserved":preserve_sessions, "offsetMs":offset, "skewMs":skew, "eachBoundary":each_boundary, "message":message, "schedules":schedules, "fired":fired, "held":held, "reportIncomplete":true, "denied":refusal_json(&error)}))
        },
    }
}

/// `POST /dev/jobs/<job>` with `{"args":{..}}`: queue one run of a job as the
/// system on the dev clock and drive chunks until it is done or parked. This is
/// what `snapback4 run <job>` forwards to while dev owns the store.
pub(super) fn run_job(request: Request, shared: &Shared, name: &str, body: &str) {
    use snapback4_core::{JobState, error::Refusal, ir::ProgramKind, wire};
    let service_route=request.url().starts_with("/jobs/");
    let service=if service_route {
        match super::session_identity::principal_of(&request,shared) {
            Ok((principal,kind,snapback4_core::identity::SessionScope::Full)) if kind=="service" && principal.starts_with("service:") => Some(principal),
            _ => return respond(request,403,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_AUTH","auth","triggering a deployed system job requires a full service token").guide("jobs"))})),
        }
    } else {
        if !shared.personas {return respond(request,403,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_AUTH","auth","/dev/jobs is a development door; use run <job> --release <dir> with a service token").guide("jobs"))}));}
        None
    };
    let refuse = |request, status, refusal: Refusal| respond(request, status, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&refusal.guide("jobs"))}));
    let payload: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(if body.trim().is_empty() { "{}" } else { body }) {
        Ok(payload) => payload,
        Err(error) => return refuse(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", format!("the request body is not JSON: {error}; send {{\"args\":{{..}}}}"))),
    };
    if service_route && !shared.personas {crate::release_requests::Scope::admit(&shared.release_requests,||*lock(&shared.generation));}
    let program = lock(&shared.bound).programs.iter().find(|p| p.program.name == name).map(|p| p.program.clone());
    let program = match program {
        Some(program) if program.kind == ProgramKind::Job => program,
        Some(other) => return refuse(request, 404, Refusal::new("E_OP", "op", format!("{name} is a {}, not a job; queries are POST /q/<op>, mutations POST /m/<op>", other.kind.word()))),
        None => return respond(request, 404, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&super::dev_doors::stale(shared, Refusal::new("E_OP", "op", format!("unknown job {name}")).guide("jobs")))})),
    };
    if let Some(raw)=payload.get("args") && let Some(why)=super::dev_doors::persona_argument(shared,&program.args,raw) {return refuse(request,400,why);}
    let mut args = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    if let Some(fields) = payload.get("args").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object) {
        for (field, value) in fields {
            let Some(kind) = program.args.get(field) else { return refuse(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", format!("{name} takes no argument {field}"))); };
            match wire::from_json(kind, value) {
                Ok(typed) => { args.insert(field.clone(), typed); }
                Err(why) => return refuse(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", format!("argument {field}: {why}"))),
            }
        }
    }
    let mut admitted=lock(&shared.engine);
    crate::release_requests::stamp(admitted.generation());
    if !service_route && let Err(why) = shared.dev_authority(&admitted) { drop(admitted); return refuse(request,403,why); }
    if let Some(service)=&service {
        if let Err(why)=super::session_identity::mutation_authority(&request,shared,&admitted,service) {drop(admitted);return refuse(request,403,why);}
    }
    let queued=admitted.enqueue_job(name,args,shared.now());
    drop(admitted);
    crate::release_requests::executed();
    let id = match queued {
        Ok(id) => id,
        Err(error) => return respond(request, 400, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error.refusal())})),
    };
    // FIFO: earlier queued runs finish first, as with `run` on a stopped store;
    // the background tick may run some chunks too, through the same engine.
    let run = loop {
        let current = {let engine=lock(&shared.engine);crate::release_requests::stamp(engine.generation());engine.job(&id)};
        match current {
            Ok(Some(run)) if matches!(run.state, JobState::Done | JobState::Parked) || crate::lifecycle::stopping() => break run,
            Ok(Some(_)) => {}
            Ok(None) => return respond(request, 500, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&RuntimeError::Store(format!("job {id} vanished")).refusal())})),
            Err(error) => return respond(request, 500, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error.refusal())})),
        }
        let (chunk, logs) = engine_work(shared, |engine, budget| (engine.run_job_chunk_for(shared.now(), budget), engine.take_native_logs()));
        for line in logs { snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: native {line}"); }
        match chunk {
            Ok(Some(chunk)) if chunk.state == JobState::Parked && shared.personas => shared.refusals.job(&chunk),
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(error) => return respond(request, 500, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error.refusal())})),
        }
    };
    snapback4_core::diagnostic!("snapback4: job {} {} on request: {} chunk{}, {} row{} written", run.name, if run.state == JobState::Done { "done" } else { "parked" },
        run.chunks, if run.chunks == 1 { "" } else { "s" }, run.rows_written, if run.rows_written == 1 { "" } else { "s" });
    respond(request, 200, json!({ "job": run.name, "id": run.id, "state": run.state, "chunks": run.chunks, "chunkSize": run.chunk_size, "retries": run.retries, "heapPeak": run.heap_peak, "rowsWritten": run.rows_written, "error": run.error }));
}

pub(super) fn clock_status(request: Request, shared: &Shared) {
    if let Err(why) = clock_service(&request, shared) { return respond(request,403,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&why)})); }
    let result = (|| {
        let (epoch, reader) = shared.reader()?;
        let note = crate::dev_clock_store::ahead(&reader, shared.now());
        lock(&shared.readers).put(&epoch, reader.into_inner());
        note
    })();
    match result {
        Ok(note) => { let now = shared.now(); respond(request, 200, json!({"storeAhead":note,"now":now,"skewMs":now - snapback4_core::now_ms()})) },
        Err(error) => respond(request, 500, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&error.refusal())})),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use super::super::tests::Host;

    #[test]
    fn dx6_current_window_drains_resume_queued_work_and_only_future_markers_refuse() {
        let store = snapback4_core::store_port::AnyStore::memory().unwrap();
        store.set_deployment_environment("staging").unwrap();
        let host = Host::with_store(false, store,
            "use identity\ntable counters:\n  n: int\n  public 'fixture'\njob tick():\n  for counter in counters:\n    update counters[counter.id] {n:counter.n+1}\nschedule hourly every 1h: tick\n");
        let hour = 3_600_000;
        let raw = (snapback4_core::now_ms() / hour + 3) * hour + 1_000;
        lock(&host.shared.clock).freeze(raw);
        let service = {
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            engine.seed_at([("counters".into(), snapback4_core::value::object([
                ("id", snapback4_core::Value::Id("counter".into())), ("n", snapback4_core::Value::Int(0)),
            ]))], raw).unwrap();
            engine.fire_schedules(raw).unwrap();
            snapback4_core::identity::service_session(engine.store(), "clock", raw, 1).unwrap()
        };
        let call = |duration: &str, drain: bool, allow_held: bool, status: u16| {
            let payload = json!({"duration":duration,"drain":drain,"allowHeld":allow_held}).to_string();
            let response = super::super::tests::exchange(host.address, &format!(
                "POST /dev/clock/advance HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\nAuthorization: Bearer {}\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{payload}", service.token, payload.len()));
            assert_eq!(super::super::tests::status(&response), status, "{response}");
            super::super::tests::body(&response)
        };
        let request = |duration: &str, drain: bool, status: u16| call(duration, drain, false, status);
        let advanced = request("2h", true, 200);
        assert_eq!(advanced["schedules"][0]["fired"], true, "{advanced}");
        let current = request("1ms", true, 200);
        assert_eq!(current["schedules"][0]["holdCode"], "not-due", "{current}");
        assert_eq!(request("1ms", false, 200)["maintenancePaused"], true);
        let now = host.shared.now();
        let (queued, saved) = {
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            (engine.enqueue_job("tick", Default::default(), now).unwrap(), crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine))
        };
        // Interrupted completion can leave already-enqueued work behind the
        // current marker. Recovery must not require accepting a future hold.
        assert_eq!(completed_drain(Work::default(), true).err().unwrap().code, "E_CLOCK_INTERRUPTED");
        let recovered = request("0ms", true, 200);
        assert_eq!(recovered["advancedMs"], 0);
        assert_eq!(recovered["now"], now);
        assert_eq!(recovered["maintenancePaused"], false);
        assert_eq!(recovered["schedules"][0]["holdCode"], "not-due", "{recovered}");
        {
            let engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            assert_eq!(crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine), saved);
            assert_eq!(engine.job(&queued).unwrap().unwrap().state, snapback4_core::JobState::Done);
            assert_eq!(engine.store().rows("counters").unwrap()[0].field("n").unwrap(), &snapback4_core::Value::Int(2));
        }
        // A strictly future marker still refuses before shifting time or
        // credentials, and leaves its queued run untouched.
        let (future_job, before, timing) = {
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let boundary = engine.schema().schedules[0].boundary(now) + hour;
            // Simulate a prior process that admitted this later window.
            engine.fire_schedule_boundary_at(boundary, 0, boundary).unwrap();
            let future_job = engine.store().job_summaries(0).unwrap().into_iter().find(|run| run.state == "queued").unwrap().id;
            let identity = engine.store().store_identity().unwrap().unwrap();
            let timing = engine.staging_session_timing(&service.token, now, &identity).unwrap().unwrap();
            (future_job, crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine), timing.expires_at)
        };
        {
            let engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let report = crate::dev_clock_store::schedule_report(&engine, &before, &[], now, now, false, false, None);
            assert_eq!(report[0]["holdCode"], "saved-boundary");
            assert_eq!(report[0]["heldUntil"], crate::dev_clock_store::utc(before[0].unwrap()));
            assert_eq!(report[0]["nextBoundary"], crate::dev_clock_store::utc(before[0].unwrap() + hour));
        }
        let refused = request("1ms", true, 400);
        assert_eq!(refused["denied"]["code"], "E_CLOCK_HELD", "{refused}");
        assert_eq!(host.shared.now(), now);
        {
            let engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            assert_eq!(crate::dev_clock_store::saved_boundaries(&engine), before);
            assert_eq!(engine.job(&future_job).unwrap().unwrap().state, snapback4_core::JobState::Queued);
            let identity = engine.store().store_identity().unwrap().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(engine.staging_session_timing(&service.token, now, &identity).unwrap().unwrap().expires_at, timing);
        }
        let catchup = before[0].unwrap() - now;
        assert!(refused["denied"]["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains(&format!("Advance {catchup}ms")), "{refused}");
        let caught_up = request(&format!("{catchup}ms"), true, 200);
        assert_eq!(caught_up["schedules"][0]["holdCode"], "not-due", "{caught_up}");
        assert_eq!(lock(&host.shared.engine).store().rows("counters").unwrap()[0].field("n").unwrap(), &snapback4_core::Value::Int(3));
        let next = request("1h", true, 200);
        assert_eq!(next["schedules"][0]["fired"], true, "{next}");
        assert_eq!(request("0ms", true, 200)["schedules"][0]["holdCode"], "not-due");
        assert_eq!(lock(&host.shared.engine).store().rows("counters").unwrap()[0].field("n").unwrap(), &snapback4_core::Value::Int(4));
        // Disclosure floors can hide a lower raw process clock. Relative
        // recovery advice must cover that hidden distance as well.
        let raw = host.shared.now() - hour;
        let floor = raw + hour + hour / 2;
        lock(&host.shared.clock).freeze(raw);
        host.shared.time_audience_clock.store(floor, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
        let saved = {
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let saved = engine.schema().schedules[0].boundary(floor) + hour;
            engine.fire_schedule_boundary_at(saved, 0, saved).unwrap();
            saved
        };
        let refused = request("1ms", true, 400);
        let duration = saved - raw;
        assert!(refused["denied"]["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains(&format!("Advance {duration}ms")), "{refused}");
        assert_eq!(lock(&host.shared.clock).now(), raw);
        let held = call("0ms", true, true, 200);
        assert_eq!(held["schedules"][0]["heldUntil"], crate::dev_clock_store::utc(saved));
        assert_eq!(held["schedules"][0]["nextBoundary"], crate::dev_clock_store::utc(saved + hour));
        assert!(held["schedules"][0]["reason"].as_str().unwrap().contains(&format!("Advance {} more", crate::dev_clock_store::span(duration))), "{held}");
        let recovered = request(&format!("{duration}ms"), true, 200);
        assert_eq!(recovered["schedules"][0]["holdCode"], "not-due", "{recovered}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn dx6_staging_preservation_uses_effective_time_above_the_disclosure_floor() {
        let store = snapback4_core::store_port::AnyStore::memory().unwrap();
        store.set_deployment_environment("staging").unwrap();
        let host = Host::with_store(false, store, "use identity\ntable timed:\n  opens: time\n  not before .opens\n  public 'fixture'\n  online only\nquery clock():\n  return now\neffect notify\nmutation queue():\n  emit notify {}\n");
        let store_id = lock(&host.shared.engine).store().store_identity().unwrap().unwrap();
        let raw = snapback4_core::now_ms() + 1_000;
        let floor = raw + 10_000;
        lock(&host.shared.clock).freeze(raw);
        host.shared.time_audience_clock.store(floor, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
        let (service, live, expired) = {
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let service = snapback4_core::identity::service_session(engine.store(), "clock", floor, 1).unwrap();
            // Construct boundary credentials through the existing identity port;
            // backdating their one-day mint gives exact expiry without raw SQL.
            let day = 86_400_000;
            let live = snapback4_core::identity::custom_session(engine.store(), "member:live", "member", floor + 500 - day, 1).unwrap();
            let expired = snapback4_core::identity::custom_session(engine.store(), "member:expired", "member", floor - 500 - day, 1).unwrap();
            let queued = engine.mutate("queue", None, snapback4_core::Context::new("member:live", Default::default()).at(floor)).unwrap();
            assert!(matches!(queued.state, snapback4_core::WriteState::Sent { .. }));
            let claimed = engine.claim_effects("service:worker", None, 1, 3_000, floor).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(claimed.len(), 1);
            assert_eq!(claimed[0].lease_until, Some(floor + 3_000));
            (service, live, expired)
        };
        let headers = format!("Authorization: Bearer {}\r\n", service.token);
        let advance = |duration: &str| {
            let payload = json!({"duration":duration,"drain":false}).to_string();
            let reply = super::super::tests::exchange(host.address, &format!("POST /dev/clock/advance HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n{headers}\r\n{payload}", payload.len()));
            assert_eq!(super::super::tests::status(&reply), 200, "{reply}");
            super::super::tests::body(&reply)
        };
        for _ in 0..2 {
            assert_eq!(advance("4s")["now"], floor);
            let engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            assert!(snapback4_core::identity::resolve_read_only(engine.store(), &expired.token, floor, Some(&store_id)).unwrap().is_none());
            let timing = engine.staging_session_timing(&live.token, floor, &store_id).unwrap().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(timing.expires_at, floor + 500, "below-floor jumps preserve the exact remaining time");
            let held = engine.effects(Some("running"), 1).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(held.len(), 1);
            assert_eq!(held[0].lease_until, Some(floor + 3_000));
        }
        // Raw time has advanced eight seconds. Crossing the ten-second floor
        // with three more seconds advances effective authority by only one.
        assert_eq!(advance("3s")["now"],floor+1_000);
        let engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
        assert!(snapback4_core::identity::resolve_read_only(engine.store(), &expired.token, floor+1_000, Some(&store_id)).unwrap().is_none());
        assert!(snapback4_core::identity::resolve_read_only(engine.store(), &live.token, floor+1_000, Some(&store_id)).unwrap().is_some());
        let timing = engine.staging_session_timing(&live.token, floor + 1_000, &store_id).unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(timing.expires_at, floor + 1_500, "exactly the original 500ms remains");
        assert!(engine.staging_session_timing(&expired.token, floor + 1_000, &store_id).unwrap().is_none(), "an expired token never shifts back to life");
        let held = engine.effects(Some("running"), 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(held.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(held[0].lease_until, Some(floor + 4_000), "leases shift by effective elapsed time once");
    }

    #[test]
    fn kit3_interrupted_clock_drain_refuses_with_clock_evidence_and_queued_work() {
        const CHILD: &str = "SNAPBACK4_KIT3_DRAIN_CHILD";
        if std::env::var_os(CHILD).is_none() {

                .args(["--exact", "serve::maintenance::tests::kit3_interrupted_clock_drain_refuses_with_clock_evidence_and_queued_work", "--nocapture"])

            return;
